stories.title: Scaffold package.json, TypeScript, Vite, Vitest, ESLint and a smoke test
acceptanceCriteria: package.json has scripts dev, typecheck, test, lint, build, build:demo, e2e, screenshots exactly as named in docs/02-plan.md Phase 1, type=module, engines.node>=20, files=[dist], sideEffects=[./dist/preload.js], optional peer @huggingface/transformers >=4 <5, and only the 10 dev dependencies listed in the plan (transformers pinned to 4.2.0)
npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run lint and npm run build all exit 0
test/smoke.test.ts asserts VERSION exported from src/index.ts equals package.json version
npm run build writes dist/index.js and dist/index.d.ts
eslint.config.js ignores dist/, dist-demo/, spike/, docs/, .cache/ and lints src/, test/, demo/, e2e/
vite.config.ts test.include is test/**/*.test.ts so e2e/ is never picked up by npm test
AGENTS.md is filled in (no template placeholders left) under 60 lines with the commands, layout and the conventions named in the plan

stories.phase: Phase 2: Event bus, tensor summaries, tensor store
stories.title: Event schema, structural types, InspectorBus with Transport and loopbackPair
acceptanceCriteria: src/events.ts exports TensorSummary, InputPreview, TopKEntry, InspectorEvent (the seven event types call:start, tokenize, run:start, run:end, logits, token, result), RequestMap, TensorData and isInspectorEvent exactly as in the plan's Event schema section
src/bus.ts exports InspectorBus (emit, on, history with maxHistory cap, handle, request with timeout, connect, clear), Transport, WireMessage, loopbackPair and InspectorError

test/fakes.ts exports fakeTensor (cpu and gpu-buffer variants; gpu data getter throws, getData resolves), fakeSession, fakeTokenizer, fakeGenerativeModel, fakePipeline and fixtureEvents with the shapes recorded in docs/01-research.md

test/bus.test.ts passes: unsubscribe works, history is capped, request/handle round trip and timeout, loopbackPair relays each event exactly once with no echo, requests are forwarded to the peer that has a handler, and every fixtureEvents() entry survives structuredClone and JSON round trip unchanged
npm test runs offline and exits 0

stories.phase: Phase 2: Event bus, tensor summaries, tensor store
stories.title: Tensor summariser, byte-budgeted TensorStore with lazy readback, input/result previews
acceptanceCriteria: src/summarize.ts exports DEFAULT_HEAD=8, bytesPerElement, elementCount, isCpuResident, headOf, summarizeTensor and readTensor with the behaviour in the plan

test/summarize.test.ts proves a gpu-buffer tensor is summarised with head=null without its data getter ever being invoked, int64 heads are plain numbers, bytes follow the dtype table, and readTensor uses getData() for non-CPU tensors
src/store.ts exports TensorStore (put, read, has, bytes, count, clear, attachTo) with a 64 MiB default budget and insertion-order eviction; the same tensor object gets the same id
test/store.test.ts proves eviction by byte budget yields {error:'evicted'}, unknown ids yield {error:'unknown'}, and attachTo(bus) answers bus.request('tensor', {id}) with the typed array
src/preview.ts exports previewInput and toCloneSafe; test/preview.test.ts covers every InputPreview branch, cycles, bigint, tensor-like values and truncation
grep -rn 'document\|window\|@huggingface' src/ returns nothing

stories.title: Panel state reducer (pure, node-tested)
acceptanceCriteria: src/panel/model.ts exports CallView, RunView, StepView, PanelState, createState and reduce as specified in the plan

test/panel-model.test.ts proves reduce(fixtureEvents()) yields 2 calls with tokenize/runs/steps/result attached to the right call, orphan run:start (callId null) opens a synthetic call labelled 'direct · <session>', orphan logits/token events attach to the newest open call, and the maxCalls cap drops the oldest
npm test passes offline

stories.title: Shadow-DOM panel: mountPanel, constructed stylesheet, collapsed badge, rows and expansion
acceptanceCriteria: src/panel/panel.ts exports mountPanel(bus, opts) returning InspectorPanel {host, shadow, open, close, isOpen, clear, destroy}; host is <div data-tjsi-panel> with an open shadow root and styles adopted via CSSStyleSheet.replaceSync with a <style> fallback

src/panel/render.ts exports renderRowSummary and renderRowDetails rendering the Input, Tokenizer, Session runs (one <tr data-tensor=id> per tensor with name, dtype, dims, location, bytes, head) and Result sections; no innerHTML and no style= attributes anywhere under src/panel (grep returns nothing)

test/panel.test.ts (happy-dom) proves: while closed, emitting fixture events creates zero [data-call] elements and the badge reads the call count; open() renders one row per call; clicking expand renders tokenizer chips and tensor rows with dims text '[1, 7, 384]'; destroy() removes the host
src/index.ts exports mountPanel, InspectorBus, loopbackPair, TensorStore and the event types
npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass

stories.title: Panel lazy tensor values and per-step top-k generation section
acceptanceCriteria: Each tensor row with an id has a 'Load values' button (data-action=load) which calls bus.request('tensor', {id}) and renders up to 4096 values plus an '… N more' note, or the error string when the response has error

Expanded rows with steps render a Generation section: one block per step with token id/text and a top-k table whose rows show token, id, logit, prob and a .bar whose width is set via CSSOM (element.style.width), not a style attribute

test/panel.test.ts proves: a bus.handle('tensor') fake returning a Float32Array leads to numbers rendered after clicking load; an {error:'evicted'} response renders the word 'evicted'; the generation fixture renders 3 steps with 10 top-k rows each
No tensor request is issued before the load button is clicked (spy on bus.request)
npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass

stories.title: WrapContext, session wrapper and tokenizer wrapper
acceptanceCriteria: src/context.ts exports InspectorOptions (head=8, topK=10, retainBytes=64 MiB, retainLogits=false, label) and WrapContext with currentCallId, tokenizer, nextCallId, nextRunId, tokenToString, now

src/wrap/session.ts exports WRAPPED = Symbol.for('transformersjs-inspector.wrapped'), wrapSession(session, name, ctx) and wrapSessions(sessions, ctx), both returning a restore function; the wrapper summarises feeds before invoking the original run

test/wrap-session.test.ts proves: run:start is emitted (with input summaries) before the fake run resolves, run:end carries matching runId, outputs and ms, a gpu-buffer output has head=null, a throwing run emits run:end with error and rethrows, wrapping twice is a no-op, and restore() reinstates the original run function identity

src/wrap/tokenizer.ts exports wrapTokenizer(tok, ctx) wrapping the instance _call; test/wrap-tokenizer.test.ts proves tokenize events carry ids as number[][] and token strings from _tokenizer.id_to_token for [1,n] and [2,n] int64 input_ids, and a tokenizer without _call produces one console.warn and no throw
npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass

stories.title: Generation wrapper: duck-typed logits processor, streamer and top-k
acceptanceCriteria: src/wrap/generation.ts exports topKFromLogits(data, k) and wrapGenerate(model, ctx) returning a restore function; the wrapper merges the caller's logits_processor (iterable or .processors) and streamer as described in the plan and never imports @huggingface/transformers
test/generation.test.ts proves topKFromLogits returns k entries sorted by prob descending with probs in (0,1] summing to <= 1 and the correct ids for a hand-built logits array

With fakeGenerativeModel (3 steps): exactly 3 logits events with vocab and 10 topK entries and exactly 3 token events with step 0..2; the first streamer.put (prompt) emits no token event; a host-supplied processor list and streamer are still invoked
With retainLogits=true each logits event carries a tensorId readable from the store; with the default false, tensorId is null
npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass

stories.title: Pipeline-call wrapper, attach()/detach(), default bus and panel auto-mount
acceptanceCriteria: src/attach.ts exports attach(pipe, opts?) and the AttachOptions/AttachHandle types from the plan; attach on a non-pipeline throws InspectorError with the message in the plan
src/default.ts exports getDefaultBus, getDefaultStore (kept on globalThis[Symbol.for('transformersjs-inspector')]) and ensurePanel (mounts once per bus, no-op when document is undefined)

test/attach.test.ts proves: attach(fakePipeline(), {panel:false, bus}) then one pipeline call emits call:start, tokenize, run:start, run:end, result in that order sharing one callId; result carries a $tensor summary for a tensor result; every event passes structuredClone; detach() restores _call, tokenizer._call, model.generate and every session.run to their original identities; attaching twice does not double-wrap sessions
src/index.ts exports attach, getDefaultBus, WRAPPED and the option/handle types
npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass

stories.phase: Phase 5: Demo page and Playwright e2e
stories.title: Demo page with feature extraction, Playwright config with persistent profile, first e2e
acceptanceCriteria: demo/tf.ts loads @huggingface/transformers@4.2.0 from the jsDelivr CDN via a dynamic import (with /* @vite-ignore */) typed as typeof import('@huggingface/transformers')

demo/index.html has three sections with data-task feature-extraction, text-generation, text-classification, each with textarea, Run button, [data-output] and a data-status attribute cycling idle/loading/running/done/error; demo/main.ts calls attach(pipe, {label}) right after each pipeline() resolves

playwright.config.ts uses a chromium project and a webServer running npm run dev on :5173; e2e/fixtures.ts overrides context with chromium.launchPersistentContext('.cache/pw-profile') so model files are cached between runs

npm run e2e -- e2e/demo.spec.ts passes with network: after running Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 the panel badge reads 1, the expanded row shows tokenizer chips including [CLS], inputs input_ids/attention_mask/token_type_ids with dims [1, N], output last_hidden_state [1, N, 384], Load values renders at least 384 numbers, and the Result section shows a $tensor with dims [1, 384]
README.md gains a Development section with npm install, npx playwright install chromium, and the six npm scripts
npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run lint still pass offline

stories.phase: Phase 5: Demo page and Playwright e2e
stories.title: Text generation and classification in the demo, generation e2e, overhead benchmark
acceptanceCriteria: The text-generation section runs onnx-community/tiny-random-LlamaForCausalLM-ONNX with {device:'auto'} and {max_new_tokens:3}; the text-classification section runs Xenova/distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english (not covered by e2e)

npm run e2e -- e2e/generation.spec.ts passes with network: the call row has >= 3 session run rows, a Generation section with exactly 3 steps each showing 10 top-k rows with probabilities in (0,1] sorted descending and a token id, and the Result section text equals the page's [data-output]
demo/main.ts implements bench(): 5 warm-up runs, 30 embeddings detached, 30 attached with the panel closed, medians and ratio written to [data-bench] and window.__bench
npm run e2e -- e2e/overhead.spec.ts passes: prints both medians and asserts ratio < 1.25; the measured ratio is appended to docs/progress.md in this story's entry

If generate rejects a plain array for logits_processor, the story switches the demo to pass opts.transformers from demo/tf.ts and records that in docs/progress.md; the plain-array path stays the default only if the e2e passes with it
npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run lint still pass offline

stories.title: Preload entry via globalThis[Symbol.for('onnxruntime')] with CDN-rewritten ORT import and e2e
acceptanceCriteria: src/preload-core.ts exports OrtLike, ORT_SYMBOL, installPreload(ort, ctx) and isInstalled(); the shim keeps ort.env and ort.Tensor by identity and wraps InferenceSession.create so returned sessions are run-wrapped via wrapSession
src/preload.ts statically imports onnxruntime-web/webgpu, installs on the default bus/store and mounts the panel when document exists; it is the only file under src/ importing onnxruntime-web

vite.shared.ts derives ORT_VERSION from node_modules/@huggingface/transformers/package.json dependencies (test/ort-pin.test.ts asserts equality, offline); vite.config.ts externalises onnxruntime-web/webgpu and rewrites it via rollupOptions.output.paths to the jsDelivr ort.webgpu.bundle.min.mjs URL; vite.demo.config.ts aliases the same specifier to that URL
npm run build produces dist/preload.js under 100 KB containing the string cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/onnxruntime-web@
test/preload.test.ts passes offline with a fake ORT: symbol set, created session emits run:start/run:end, double install is a no-op

npm run e2e -- e2e/preload.spec.ts passes with network: demo/preload.html never calls attach(), uses device:'auto', and the panel shows one row labelled with session#1 and last_hidden_state [1, N, 384]
README.md has a Zero-touch preload section stating the device:'auto' requirement and the ORT version coupling
npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass

stories.title: messagePortTransport, connectWorker/exposeToPage, worker demo and e2e
acceptanceCriteria: src/worker.ts exports PortLike, messagePortTransport(port), connectWorker(worker, bus?) and exposeToPage(bus, port?); the transport ignores messages without __tjsi===1 and calls port.start?.()

test/worker.test.ts passes offline using Node's MessageChannel: an event emitted on the worker-side bus arrives exactly once on the page-side bus, and page.request('tensor', {id}) is answered by the worker-side TensorStore with a Float32Array; ports are closed so the run exits
vite.config.ts has a worker entry; npm run build produces dist/worker.js that does not contain panel code (grep for 'data-tjsi-panel' returns nothing)

npm run e2e -- e2e/worker.spec.ts passes with network: demo/worker.html runs Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 inside a module worker that calls attach(pipe, {bus, panel:false}) and exposeToPage; the page panel shows 1 row with last_hidden_state and Load values renders >= 384 numbers fetched across the worker boundary
No file under src/panel/ is modified by this story
npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass

stories.title: Package exports map, README with screenshots, LICENSE, pack check
acceptanceCriteria: package.json exports map has '.', './preload' and './worker' entries with types and import conditions pointing at dist/, plus main/types, license MIT, keywords and repository
npm run build succeeds and node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m => { if (typeof m.attach !== 'function') process.exit(1) })" exits 0
npm pack --dry-run lists only dist/**, README.md, LICENSE and package.json
npm run screenshots writes docs/img/panel-embedding.png and docs/img/panel-generation.png from the demo page, and README.md embeds both

README.md covers: one-paragraph purpose, attach() usage, options table, event schema pointer, zero-touch preload with the device:'auto' caveat, worker usage, what is not visible (no per-layer activations), development commands and the two fixture models
npm run build:demo produces dist-demo/index.html; npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass
